import math

def _check_int(value, name, minimum):
    """Ensure *value* is an ``int`` >= *minimum* (rejecting ``bool``)."""
    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, int):
        raise ValueError(
            f"{name} must be an int >= {minimum}, not {type(value).__name__}"

    if value < minimum:
        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be an int >= {minimum}, not {value}")


def _check_size(size):

def _check_items(items):

            f"items must be a list, not {type(items).__name__}"

def page_count(total, size):
    """Return the number of pages needed to hold *total* items.

    ``total`` must be an ``int`` >= 0 (not a ``bool``) and ``size`` an
    ``int`` >= 1 (not a ``bool``); otherwise a ``ValueError`` is raised.

    Returns ``ceil(total / size)`` with one documented legacy exception:
    an empty collection still has exactly one (empty) page, so
    ``page_count(0, size) == 1``.
    """

    _check_size(size)
    if total == 0:
        return 1
    return math.ceil(total / size)


def slice_page(items, page, size):
    """Return the *page*-th page (0-based) of the list *items*.

    ``items`` must be a ``list`` (else ``TypeError``); ``page`` must be an
    ``int`` >= 0 (not a ``bool``) and ``size`` must be an ``int`` >= 1
    (not a ``bool``) (else ``ValueError``).

    Page ``p`` is ``items[p*size:(p+1)*size]``; the final page may be
    partial, and a page beyond the end returns ``[]`` (not an error).
    """
    _check_items(items)
    _check_int(page, "page", 0)
    _check_size(size)
    return items[page * size:(page + 1) * size]


def iter_pages(items, size):
    """Return all pages of the list *items* in order.

    ``items`` must be a ``list`` (else ``TypeError``); ``size`` must be an
    ``int`` >= 1 (not a ``bool``) (else ``ValueError``).

    The result contains exactly ``page_count(len(items), size)`` pages,
    each a list. For empty ``items`` that is ``[[]]`` — one empty page,
    the same legacy rule as ``page_count``.
    """
    _check_items(items)
    _check_size(size)
    return [
        slice_page(items, page, size)
        for page in range(page_count(len(items), size))
    ]
